description: Elections Commission - Declare that S. S. Sasikumar as a Member of the Karaitivu P/S. and Declare that K. Kumarasiri as a Member of the Karaitivu P/S
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in a local government body (Karaitivu Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the declaration of selected members to fill positions vacated by resignation. The content focuses on electoral procedures and member declarations rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or any other specialized category.
